description: This file defines the 'AttributeCreated' event class in Java, representing an event emitted after an attribute of a 'thing' was created. It includes methods for constructing, serializing, and deserializing instances, and encapsulates details about the attribute change.

classes.name: AttributeCreated
classes.description: Immutable event class representing the creation of an attribute in a 'thing'. It provides details about the attribute's key and value, as well as serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a new AttributeCreated event with provided parameters, including optional metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AttributeCreated instance from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the event data.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the pointer of the attribute that was created.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the created attribute.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers.
